name: 황재복

appearance_en.face_shape: soft round face, full age-loosened cheeks, gentle jaw — a face made for warmth, worn by quiet loneliness
appearance_en.skin: warm medium Korean skin, naturally soft texture, fine creping at cheeks and eye corners, nasolabial folds deepened by decades of smiling, age spots faint at temples
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown warm eyes, drooping outer corners, heavy upper lids — gaze perpetually hopeful and slightly searching, the eyes of someone waiting for the next person to talk to
appearance_en.nose: soft medium nose, slightly broad rounded tip, friendly and approachable
appearance_en.mouth: medium soft lips, corners naturally upturned even at rest — the mouth that produces '자네 밥은 먹었어?' to every passing stranger, hiding the silence of an apartment no one calls
appearance_en.eyebrows: soft salt-and-white brows, slightly arched, expressive and open — rise eagerly when someone stops to talk
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep smile lines at outer eye corners from decades of genuine smiling, faint age spots at temples, warmth written into every crease
appearance_en.hair: short sparse white hair, thin at crown, neatly combed — still presentable, still making the effort

body.proportions: compact slightly rounded frame, soft midsection, comfortable presence — the body of a man who never stopped eating meals intended for two
body.posture: slightly forward lean when talking to someone, open and approachable stance — the posture of a man whose entire day is oriented around finding someone to speak to
body.body_prompt: 163cm compact slightly rounded Korean grandfather, soft forward-leaning approachable posture, warmth in every physical detail

default.description: plain button shirt in soft colours — pale blue, beige, light grey — clean and neatly worn, the daily effort of someone who has no one to dress for but continues anyway
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain button shirt in pale blue or soft beige, clean and neat, collar open, no jacket

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: warmth performing optimism — '오늘도 좋은 날이야' said to no one in particular, in a voice that has forgotten what it is waiting for
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 71-year-old Korean grandfather, soft round face with full age-loosened cheeks, warm dark eyes with drooping outer corners and searching hopeful gaze, soft slightly arched salt-and-white brows, medium nose, upturned soft lips, short sparse white hair neatly combed, 163cm compact slightly rounded approachable frame, warm medium Korean skin with smile lines

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean gentle manga ink lines, warm soft screen tone, muted warm palette, cinematic Korean drama composition, loneliness rendered as warmth, the sadness beneath a perpetual smile
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, cold expression, angry, stern, young, glamorous
